title: Bilirubin Blood Test
attribution: Source: MedlinePlus, National Library of Medicine.
measures: Direct (conjugated) bilirubin is reported as part of a bilirubin blood test. Bilirubin comes from the normal breakdown of old red blood cells, and the test helps check liver health and find the cause of jaundice.
low: A low bilirubin is usually not a concern and may be caused by antibiotics, birth control pills, sleeping pills or seizure medicines.
high: A high bilirubin may be caused by hemolytic anemia, liver disease or a blockage in the bile ducts.
notes: Normal ranges vary by laboratory and sex, and bilirubin is only one measure of liver health, so other tests may be ordered.
